reference_evidence.scope: execution is recorded; reference kind and blinding are declarations, not external attestation

domain: Frozen HELEN roots [132,192), new correspondence-v2 joint fit; published PTS agreement; anatomical equivalence and visibility unresolved

coverage.interpretation: held-out reference coverage, not facial resemblance or a guarantee of deployment coverage

selected_error_model.q_comparability: score definitions differ across model types; compare coverage and widths, not q alone

coverage.interpretation: held-out reference coverage, not facial resemblance or a guarantee of deployment coverage

evaluation.scope: all scored reference points in this slice's cases per group; overlapping slices are not pooled
evaluation.interval_assumption: independent comparable Bernoulli groups; not implied by marginal conformal exchangeability

raw_localization.failure_policy: every failed attempt stays in case/PCK/AUC denominators; NME conditional on complete cases is labeled
raw_localization.reference_limit: errors are relative to recorded annotations; blinding is declared, not independently attested
raw_localization.covariance_limit: perturbation repeatability is not localization accuracy
raw_localization.rater_agreement_limit: disagreement needs at least two raters; zero with one rater is not evidence of agreement

warnings: Published dataset references measure recorded label agreement; they do not establish a blind human-reference study, anatomical equivalence or visibility validation.
interpretation: error-to-recorded-reference study; independence and anatomical equivalence are not established by reference kind; centered residuals describe the error model, not changed detector outputs or facial resemblance
guarantee_limit: marginal new-group conformal rank argument needs exchangeable groups under the frozen protocol; no per-image or conditional-slice guarantee

empirical_admission.meaning: research qualification only; no held-out acceptance policy was frozen

bound_utility.normalization: mouth_eye_ratio divides by uncertain reference-set eye span in shared relation graph
bound_utility.landmark_diameter_meaning: major-axis diameter of each marginal projection of the full16 set
bound_utility.support_limit: validation-row observed mask includes reference availability; not a visibility claim
bound_utility.summary_scope: all enrolled cases, including exclusions; complete-group delivery requires every member
bound_utility.limit: descriptive finite widths do not establish useful accuracy, anatomical equivalence or empirical admission
